text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU OOM during prefill on gpu-pool-7. Detected 5 container restarts in 3m. Affected model: redwood/open-7b-quant v3. Trigger appears to be a single long-session prefill. Alert: https://alerts.internal/redwood/2987650007
sre-alex: Ack. Paging oncall. Any immediate customer impact?
priya-ml: We see a noisy tenant (AcmeCorp) sending a single prefill ~120k tokens. KV cache grew >36GB -> CUDA OOM on allocation. Recommend immediate mitigations: disable aggressive prefetch on pool, enable KV-cache eviction, and route that tenant to cold-model fallback.
alice-eng: Pulling logs now: `kubectl -n runtime logs pod/serve-eu-7 -c runtime | tail -n 60`
alice-eng: ```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 8.00 GiB (GPU 0; total 48.00 GiB; already allocated 42.10 GiB)
  File "/srv/runtime/serve.py", line 412, in handle_prefill
    kv_cache.append(prefill_chunk)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/torch/cuda/memory.py", line 123, in allocate
    raise RuntimeError("CUDA out of memory")
```
ml-ops-nina: We can flip pool prefetch to 0 with the control plane CLI: `redwoodctl pools update gpu-pool-7 --prefetch 0` (will apply to new pods). Also recommending kvcache trim policy: set eviction='aggressive' for sessions >50k tokens.
priya-ml: If control-plane change is slow, temporarily set per-tenant circuit-breaker to reject prefill >60k tokens: `redwoodctl tenants patch acmecorp --max_prefill_tokens 60000`
sre-alex: Oncall, please apply the pool prefetch change and add the aggressive eviction. I'll prepare routing rule to cold-model fallback for that tenant.
oncall-bot: ONCALL: @sre-alex assigned (rotation-2). Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/prefill_oom. Incident severity: P1 (customer-facing 502s).
ben-customer-success: Ben here. AcmeCorp reported 502s and timeouts around 09:12 UTC. They want an ETA and whether data was lost.
alice-eng: Applied quick patch: `kubectl set env configmap/pool-gpu-pool-7 PREFETCH=0` -> new pods are rolling. Observed restarts drop shortly after redeploy.
incident-bot: Update: restarts decreased 5->1 in last 5m. The noisy pod (serve-eu-7) still shows occasional OOM when handling the handshake prefill. Monitoring.
ml-ops-nina: Aggressive eviction policy applied for sessions >50k tokens. Also enabled coldmodel-fallback rule for tenant acmecorp via `redwoodctl routes add --tenant acmecorp --fallback coldmodel-eu`
priya-ml: Short-term plan: (1) prefetch=0 + kvcache eviction (done), (2) route tenant to coldmodel (done), (3) push control-plane quota for max prefill tokens and circuit-breaker in next release.
sre-alex: Ben, ask CS to send AcmeCorp a status update: we're mitigating with config changes and routing to a fallback model; no data loss expected, only degraded latency while we stabilize. CS ETA: 10m for update.
ben-customer-success: Sending update to customer now. Will escalate if they push back. :thumbsup:
alice-eng: Captured logs and created incident ticket: INC-298765 (link: https://incidents.internal/INC-298765). Attaching pod logs and OOM traces.
priya-ml: Postmortem action items: add prefill token quota, control-plane enforcement for per-tenant prefill limits, add graceful kvcache trimming during prefill, and improve alerting to correlate tenant IDs. I'll start a draft.
incident-bot: Status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will clear alert when restarts=0 for 15 continuous minutes.
sre-alex: Leaving this thread open until we hit steady-state 15m. If anyone sees new restarts, ping with pod name.
ben-customer-success: Confirmed customer updated and satisfied for now. Closing customer comms loop.
ml-ops-nina: Follow-up: scheduling a small canary of control-plane quota rollout to internal staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
priya-ml: Thanks everyone. We'll keep notes for the postmortem.
